## Kerendia Speaker Program
### High-Frequency Performance Tracker
*NBRx Lift = avg post-window NBRx/HCP − avg pre-window NBRx/HCP (rolling monthly cohorts, all programs). New Writer = zero Kerendia NBRx in 12 months pre-event who wrote post-window. Data refreshes weekly with v6 source.*

description.value: Aug–Sep 2026 excluded (incomplete data windows). KPI counters above reflect all-time totals.

lines:
## Program Effectiveness
*Did behavior change? How much?*

**Methodology:** Lift is measured as pre/post NBRx change per HCP. "Attended" = HCPs who attended ≥1 speaker program; "Not Attended" = matched control. The 4w vs 12w pivot on P6 compares early signal (28-day) vs durable change (84-day). A positive lift means more scripts were written after the program than before.

## Audience Segmentation
*What factors drove the change?*

**Segment A** (existing writers): measured by NBRx lift — did they write more after attending? **Segment B** (non-writers): measured by new-writer conversion — did they start prescribing? Different segments require different success metrics.

## Frequency & Exposure
*How much exposure drives the most change?*

**Dose-response:** Lift by number of programs attended (1, 2, 3+). **Call coverage:** % of attendees with a rep follow-up call within 30 days post-event. Higher exposure and timely follow-up are expected to amplify lift.

## Engagement Journey
*Where does the funnel leak? What's the conversion path?*

**NBA Funnel:** Alert → Invitation (60d window) → Attendance (60d window). The bottleneck is alert-to-invite (~1–2%), not invite-to-attend (~25–30%). Counts show absolute HCPs at each stage; conversion % is invite-to-attend rate.

## NBA Initiative Spotlight
*Is the targeted alert-to-attend pathway driving measurable Rx impact?*

NBA alerts began **July 2026**. HCPs are classified by engagement depth: **Attended** (alert → invite → program), **Invited Only** (alert → invite, no program), **Not Invited** (alert only, no invite). Each section compares Rx behavior change across these three cohorts to isolate the incremental value of deeper engagement.

*Invite/Attend windows: 30 days post-cycle date. NBRx Lift = avg post-window NBRx/HCP − avg pre-window NBRx/HCP, measured 28 days after the anchor date. New Writer = zero Kerendia NBRx in 12 months pre-alert who wrote within the 4-week post-window.*
